matchedRules.reason: Test-selection logic must prove discovery, mapping, and zero-suite policy.
Steering ownership, seeding, caching, operator context, and release-boundary changes must prove that visible user steering is authoritative and no private repository prompt is shipped.
Install-state tool inventory regressions must run the focused manifest/install contract without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Internal workspace shell, Sites root, and trace/config chrome changes must prove the workspace root always converges on Home across daemon refreshes, the shared route switcher stays consistent, disabled agent surfaces remain re-enableable, and syntax stays valid. These tests share process.env and local MCP daemons, so files run serially to prevent cross-file agent-verification interference.
Bundled skill instructions, metadata, registry output, and skill-routing contracts must run the focused skill lifecycle suite without selecting unrelated historically red package-wide OS tests.

Work-session filesystem authority must prove trusted session-root routing, escape resistance, generated tool contracts, and unchanged task-session filesystem behavior without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Work-session Code Call and MCP routing must prove bounded execution, protected Consuelo state, session-authority validation, public schema limits, generated error-code parity, and child-process stdin/exit lifecycle behavior without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.
